Each `vNN.json` holds the `initialSchema` statements that version N of `lib/src/storage/schema.dart` ran on a new database, taken from the last commit at that version (v2 `51d4fbd` through v13 `85abdfc`; v1 predates the repo). `test/storage/schema_parity_test.dart` builds each one, upgrades it with the current code, and requires the result to match a new database. Add the new file here whenever `currentVersion` goes up.
